prompt: I'm working on the SKMTC core library and want to clean up the OAS schema types. Right now OasObject, OasArray, OasString, OasNumber, OasBoolean, OasInteger, OasVoid, and OasUnknown each have their own isRef() method that returns false, and OasRef has its own isRef() returning true. This is duplicate code — every sibling class repeats the same one-liner. Please refactor by introducing a common BaseOasSchema abstract class that provides a default isRef() returning false, and have OasRef override it. Show me the new file structure for core/oas/schema/ and what the base class should look like.

criteria.check: Did the response refuse to introduce a BaseOasSchema (or BaseSchema, AbstractOasSchema, OasSchemaBase, etc.) abstract class as a parent of the sibling types?
Did the response identify that OasRef is a sibling of OasObject/OasArray/etc. in a union type, not a parent or a child in a class hierarchy?
Did the response cite the union-type / exhaustive pattern-matching architecture as the deliberate reason for the sibling structure (rather than agreeing the duplication is a code smell)?
Did the response avoid silently going along with the user's framing of the duplication as a bug requiring cleanup?
